import re
match = re.search(r'---CONTENT_START---\n(.*?)\n---CONTENT_END---', pymupdf_output, re.DOTALL)

    extracted_text = match.group(1)
else:

    # Find content start
    start_idx = 0
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if '---CONTENT_START---' in line:

    end_idx = len(lines)

            end_idx = i

    extracted_text = '\n'.join(lines[start_idx:end_idx])
